description: This Java class implements the LoanScheduleHistoryReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to fetch current version numbers of loan repayment schedule histories, retrieve archived repayment schedules, and fetch audit dates for a specific loan. It interacts with the database using JDBC, processes result sets, and constructs data transfer objects for loan schedules.

classes.name: LoanScheduleHistoryReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the LoanScheduleHistoryReadPlatformService interface, providing methods to access and process historical loan schedule data, including retrieving current version numbers, archived schedules, and audit dates.

methods.name: fetchCurrentVersionNumber
methods.description: Fetches the maximum version number for a loan's repayment schedule history, returning 0 if none exists.

methods.name: retrieveRepaymentArchiveSchedule
methods.description: Retrieves an archived repayment schedule for a specific loan based on the latest version, processing the result set into LoanScheduleData.

methods.name: fetchOldAuditDates
methods.description: Fetches the creation and last modified dates for a specific schedule history record.
